name: John Stephenson
bio: John Stephenson (born August John Stephenson; August 9, 1923 in Kenosha, Wisconsin, U.S.) is an American actor and voice actor. He is best remembered for his voice acting in the original Flintstones and Scooby-Doo TV cartoon series. He has also been credited as John Stevenson.
